title: The suite runs per-AC strict coverage and fails the pipeline on any gap
asA: reviewer accountable for the RCF chain on merge
iWant: the pipeline to have already run `rcf audit coverage --strict` and refused on any AC without a resolving TC
soThat: a merge that ships an AC unbound to a TC is impossible

acceptanceCriteria.description: The suite invokes `rcf audit coverage --strict` as a required gate after `rcf define validate`. The gate's exit code, captured stdout, and captured stderr are written to a per-gate report at the configured stable path.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pipeline has run against the head commit
acceptanceCriteria.when: the reviewer opens the per-gate report file at `<reportDir>/coverage-strict.json`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the file exists, its `gate` field is `coverage-strict`, its `command` field names the `rcf audit coverage --strict` invocation, its `exitCode` field records the underlying process exit code, and its `stdout` and `stderr` fields carry the captured streams

acceptanceCriteria.description: A non-zero exit from `rcf audit coverage --strict` (exit 4 on gaps, per mechanism) marks the aggregate verdict as failed and the aggregate exit code as non-zero. The suite never substitutes shallow-any coverage for strict coverage.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an invocation of the suite against a tree with a deliberately uncovered AC
acceptanceCriteria.then: the aggregate report's `verdict` field is `failed`, its `gates[]` entry for `coverage-strict` records `outcome: failed` with the underlying exit code preserved, and no gate report on disk records a shallow-any invocation for coverage
